name: OVHaiLLM/Olala-v1.0-mini-7A1B model card + technical report link
notes: Card read 2026-11-22. Custom architecture (OlalaForCausalLM, model_type olala, custom_code, transformers 5.8.0): 36 layers from layers_config 'MMMMVMMMMVMMMMVMMMMVMMMMVMMMMVMMMMVM' = 29 Mamba-3 (M) + 7 differential-attention (V) layers at indices 4, 9, 14, 19, 24, 29, 34, i.e. one attention layer in five. Every layer is followed by a latent MoE block: 256 routed experts, 6 active per token, 1 shared expert, routed_intermediate 768 from routed_input_dim 384, shared_intermediate 1536, routed_scaling 2.45. hidden 1536, num_attention_heads 48, head_dim 128, mla_kv_rank 128 with num_key_value_heads 0 (MLA-compressed KV), sliding_window_size 65536, vocab 151936. Card prints '6.8B total, about 1B active per token', 32K context (input + output) with a 128K version promised, Apache 2.0, 12.8T training tokens on JUPITER (1,024 GH200) / Jean Zay / MeluXina. Config.json max_position_embeddings is 100000, which is MORE than the card's supported 32K - the card's number is treated as the served limit. Performance section prints one 19-model, 13-benchmark table (IFBench, Multi-IF, LIFEBench, GPQA Diamond, TruthfulQA, DROP, HumanEval+, MBPP+, AIME 2024/2025/2026, MGSM, BFCL V3) and states a 68.0 twelve-benchmark average, 15.2 points above its own SFT checkpoint. Comparison rows include Granite 4.0-H-Tiny 7B-A1B, LFM2.5 8B-A1B, Ling 3.0-tiny 7.9B-A1.3B, OLMoE 1B-7B, LFM3-1.7B, Qwen3.5-2B/4B, LFM2.5 2.6B, Ministral 3-3B/8B-Reasoning, SmolLM3-3B, Apertus 8B, EuroLLM 9B, Falcon H1R-7B, Mistral 7B-v0.3, Olmo 3-7B-Think, Luciole 23B-Instruct/Thinking.
